remarks: Welcome to 1919 Boies Road. An extraordinary custom-built Forbes Capretto residence where exceptional craftsmanship and modern luxury come together on 3 scenic acres in top rated East Aurora Schools. Built in 2020 with over 2,800 square feet of living space, this one-of-a-kind estate offers an expansive, flexible floor plan with an impressive list of features. Curb appeal is immediate with professional landscaping, a maintenance-free stone and vinyl exterior and dramatic elevations. The entry foyer opens to a bright, welcoming open-concept main level designed for everyday living and entertaining. The gourmet chef’s kitchen features a spectacular 13 foot granite island, walk-in pantry, stainless appliances, travertine tile backsplash and abundant solid-wood, soft-close cabinetry. The kitchen flows into the impressive great room, where soaring ceilings and expansive windows capture breathtaking backyard views. The first-floor primary suite offers a private retreat with a spa-like bath featuring a double-sink granite vanity and walk-in closet. Formal dining room, den and half bath provide additional versatility. The first-floor laundry and utility room, off the 25x25 attached side-load garage, provides storage and workspace. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms are complemented by a cork-floored loft and second full bath. The 2,142 square foot basement with two egress windows is partially finished and adds possibilities for almost 5,000 total square feet of living space between the three levels combined. Peace of mind comes standard with an architectural roof, high-efficiency furnace and central air system, generator-ready hookup and two 150-amp electrical services. The resort-style backyard features multiple concrete patios and a spectacular 20x40 Majestic in-ground heated saltwater pool. The grounds offer privacy and opportunities to enjoy the outdoors, with mature magnolia, maple, river birch, willow and apple trees, established gardens, a horseshoe driveway and two outbuildings. Located just minutes from the Village of East Aurora, this exquisite property offers the combination of custom construction, privacy, luxury and convenience.
